points.text: The Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to resume deporting migrants to third countries while it considers the policy’s legality; arguments are set for December.
OpenAI introduced always-on Dots agents and GPT-6.1 Sol, while withholding GPT-6.1 Astra after internal testing raised safety concerns.
An independent commission found Manchester City guilty of all charges involving Premier League financial-rule breaches from 2009-10 to 2017-18; the club plans to appeal.
Attackers are exploiting critical zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler systems, deploying web shells and other malware; organizations are urged to check for compromise and apply updates.
AMD agreed to acquire AI research startup World Labs in an all-stock deal valued at about $8.2 billion; co-founder Fei-Fei Li will join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist.
